definitions.gloss: upper rank, higher position, top tier
definitions.explanation: A higher position within a ranking, hierarchy, or classification. Used in competitive contexts such as sports, academics, business, and search results.

examples.japanese: {上位|じょうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
⟦{検索|けんさく}→検索：04729_kensaku⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上位|じょうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}される→表示する：26973_hyoujisuru⟧。
examples.english: Appear at the top of search results.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{上位|じょうい}{三名|さんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{賞金|しょうきん}→賞金：14234_shoukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{贈|おく}られる→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: At this year's tournament, prize money will be awarded to the top three.

notes:
{上位|じょうい} refers to the higher end of a ranking or hierarchy. Its counterpart is ⟦{下位|かい}→下位：11710_kai⟧ (lower rank).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上位|じょうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (place in the top ranks)
- {上位|じょうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食|く}い{込|こ}む→食い込む：06236_kuikomu⟧ (break into the top ranks)
- {上位|じょうい}⟦ランキング→ランキング：11195_rankingu⟧ (top ranking)
- {上位|じょうい}{互換|ごかん} (upward compatibility)
- {売|う}り{上|あ}げ{上位|じょうい} (top sellers)
- {上位|じょうい}⟦{概念|がいねん}→概念：04709_gainen⟧ (superordinate concept)

USAGE:
- Often used as a prefix modifier: {上位|じょうい}⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧ (higher-end model), {上位|じょうい}⟦{機種|きしゅ}→機種：13211_kishu⟧ (higher-end model/device)
- Common in business, technology, and sports contexts
